summary: Nanoviricides, Inc. filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for an at-the-market (ATM) offering of up to $4,018,069 of common stock through sales agent D. Boral Capital. The filing is a routine equity shelf takedown under Rule 415, not a special situation. Compensation is a 2% commission on gross sales price. Shares trade on NYSE American under NNVC. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or other event occurs; this is ordinary capital raising.
